answer: Each epoch a random 5% of identities face a rotating peer audit: three established agents verify one work artifact, like a signed code commit or settled trade receipt. That artifact is the nectar each identity must keep producing; an agent with none is a relic of a dead farm. Each identity locks 1,000 POA for 45 days; a failed audit slashes 100% and freezes its cluster. Forging 200 identities needs 200 histories at $40 each plus 200,000 POA locked. A 150-agent ring was caught when 132 audits traced to one marble-quarry of identical receipts from a buyer.
